dedupe_keys.name: nordic textile anatomy from danish retail and swedish post consumer garments 2022

description: This database records garment fibre composition, layers and attached findings relevant to textile sorting and recycling. Technical University of Denmark and collaborators collected two samples in 2022: 4,495 garments at Copenhagen mass-market retailers and 1,248 post-consumer garments around the SIPTEX sorting line in Malmö. The repository provides an Excel workbook and CSV exports, with fibre and garment-category reference tables. Coverage differs between the Danish retail and Swedish waste samples, and the latter includes more detailed lining and finding information. DTU Data explicitly licenses the release under MIT with free access. Different seasons, sampling stages and variable detail are limitations when comparing the two groups or estimating total regional waste. Modellers could derive sorting yields, pre-processing needs and recycling-capacity scenarios for simulation. platform-openlca supplies a related environmental-assessment tool; these anatomy tables need separate process and throughput inputs. No garment rows were downloaded or sampled independently.
name: Nordic textile anatomy from Danish retail and Swedish post-consumer garments, 2022
